name: Erqi Yangtze River Bridge
facts: The Erqi Yangtze River Bridge, spanning 2,922 metres, carries eight lanes of Wuhan's Second Ring Road across the Yangtze, reshaping regional traffic flow since its opening on December 31, 2011.
Featuring two main cable‑stayed spans of 616 metres each, the Erqi Bridge claims the title of the world’s longest double‑span cable‑stayed bridge, a record set during its 2008‑2011 construction.
Construction of the Erqi Yangtze River Bridge began in 2008, culminating in a grand opening at the end of 2011, marking a milestone in China’s rapid infrastructure expansion.
